settings.heading: Privacy
settings.intro: What we collect, why we collect it, and how to ask us to delete it.
settings.fallback_content:
This policy is issued by [Legal]. It applies to this website and to orders placed through it.

What we collect

Order details, contact details you give us, and technical data needed to run the site (for example, cookies that keep your basket and market preference).

What you tell us about feel

If you write to us about how the mattress should feel, we use that to adjust the comfort layer. We keep it only as long as we need it to get the bed right.

How we use it

To fulfil your order, send status updates, answer support requests, and improve the site. We do not sell your data.

Sharing

We share data with payment, delivery, and email providers only as needed to complete an order or send a message you asked for.

Your rights

Email us to access, correct, or delete your data. We will confirm in writing.
